toolchain.adb_note: Use the SDK adb at adb_path. /run/current-system/sw/bin/adb (35.0.2) is first on PATH; mixing both versions restarts the adb server.

android_reference_device.screen_and_input: emulator window on host display; adb exec-out screencap -p; adb shell input
android_reference_device.state_at_handover: Running on emulator-5560 with a window on the host display before the task is handed over. Another emulator (emulator-5556) belongs to a different project: never use or stop it; always pass -s emulator-5560.
android_reference_device.note: userdebug AOSP image; system partition writable, verity disabled (organizer uses this for system certificate trust). Do not modify system trust or disable TLS verification.

certificate_trust: Host (/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt) and Android system stores trust the public web PKI plus the organizer's local CA used by food_api_base_url. No action needed; do not bypass TLS verification in the app or CLI.
network: Internet access available. Use food_api_base_url for food data; do not call the live Open Food Facts API.
food_api_note: Provided HTTPS endpoint of the same read-only Open Food Facts contract (P08), serving products sold in Germany from the official OFF database dump of 2026-09-22 (ODbL). Reachable from host and from the reference device (via adb reverse). Product image URLs still point to images.openfoodfacts.org.
working_conditions: No limit on development time, tokens, cost or iterations.
